history.content: hi. um i dont really know how to use this lol. i guess im just kind of all over the place today and someone said writing it out helps so. here i am i guess
Hey, that’s completely fine — we can just keep it loose. What’s been most all over the place today?

ok so its like. my contract at work ends in september and theyve been super vague about whether theyre renewing it. and i moved cities for this job last year. so like everything is kind of up in the air? and i keep going back and forth between being annoyed at them for not telling me and being like terrified that ill have to start over again somewhere new. idk its a lot of both at the same time
That sounds like a mix of being stuck in the dark with them and feeling scared about having to start over. Which part is loudest right now — the annoyed part or the terrified part?

honestly the terrified one. like the annoyed thing is almost easier? its cleaner. i can just be mad at my manager and thats simple. but underneath it is this thing where i lie awake doing math about how many months of rent i have saved and what if i have to pack everything up again and i dont even have like. roots here yet, i barely know anyone, and the thought of doing that whole thing over makes me feel exhausted before its even happened. sorry thats a lot

That feels like terror with a tired, braced edge — like it pulls you into counting, packing, and trying to face the whole thing before it happens. Does it make you want to check, plan, or just freeze?

check, definitely check. like ill refresh my work email at 11pm for no reason. or ill open a job site and just scroll listings in other cities even though i dont even want to leave, i think im just trying to feel like i have a backup so i dont feel so powerless waiting on them. but then it just makes me more wound up. its like i cant sit still in the not-knowing

That makes sense — the checking seems to be trying to give you some backup in the not-knowing, even if it leaves you more wound up. Want to leave it there for now, or stay with what the not-knowing is asking for?

yeah maybe i can stay with that for a sec. i think the not-knowing is asking me to just... admit i cant control when they decide. which i hate lol. but maybe the move isnt to find more certainty its to be okay not having it for a few more weeks. like i can ask my manager once for a real timeline and then actually let it go instead of refreshing at midnight. that feels less awful than what im doing now at least
That sounds like the not-knowing is asking for permission to stop gripping so hard, even though you hate that. Does that feel more like relief, dread, or both?

both, but lighter than when i sat down. like a little relief that i dont have to solve the whole future tonight, and a little dread cause letting go is scary too. but ok. i think thats enough for now, i feel a bit more like a person again. thank you for this, genuinely
I’m glad it feels a bit lighter, and I can leave it here with you. Come back anytime if you want to pick it up again.
